raw_data_preservation: immutable prior inputs; derived full original-observation and residue-audit fields retained
eligibility: inherited exact experimental Kd, explicit reference protein sequence, SMILES available; same legacy primary/entity/endpoint/concentration/metadata-only exclusion flags applied to NC and standard controls
caps_topology_tags: terminal caps, cyclization, linkers and assay labels retained as independent flags; caps alone are not NC core
target_view: database reference protein sequence; no observed assay construct certified
grouping_input: label-free-grouping-input.jsonl plus label-free-study-aliases.jsonl; numeric affinity is absent

dependency_edges: one-substitution raw strings length>=5 including X with same position
source_peptide_panel.partition: union-find transitive components, never split any component; deterministic largest-component greedy allocation toward 70/15/15 using counts only; actual ratios reported
source_peptide_panel.claim_boundary: zero overlap for declared source/peptide dependency definitions; target similarity may cross

target_panel.homology: Bio.Align1.85 optimal local BLOSUM62, gap open=-10 extend=-0.5; first optimal alignment; identity exact matches/nongap paired columns>=0.30, paired-column/full-reference coverage>=0.80 for both
target_panel.extra_edges: exact sequence containment when shorter length>=40 aa
target_panel.all_pair_guarantee: all main-main and external-main pairs examined or mathematically excluded by impossible paired-column coverage or amino-acid composition upper bound; no heuristic sequence prefilter
target_panel.claim_boundary: declared full-reference similarity and exact domain containment; not a universal protein-family guarantee; source and peptide neighbors may cross
target_panel.effective_input_edges: identical first1000 target amino acids; all five planned methods have >=1000 prefix views, MGraph1200; full SMILES retained

dual_cold_panel: diagnostic only; largest component 8948/9619=93.02%; not a primary table
tuning: fit preprocessing on training only; hyperparameters and stopping only from validation; test and external labels never used for architecture, tuning, split selection or model selection
reporting: per-seed test predictions and exact record ids, fitted checkpoint and hyperparameters, MAE/RMSE/Pearson/Spearman/R2, mean and sample standard deviation across 10 seeds, mutually exclusive residue strata, optional macro per target/source; no finite correlation claimed for constant or undersized groups
canonical_comparison: same assay endpoint, same cohort-wide component split, same models and hyperparameter budget; canonical data are controls with reported cap/topology flags, not declared fully unmodified
external_rule: held from training/tuning; source aliases checked against all PPIKB, graph/effective-input and target relationships audited; source-independent, entity-independent and target-cold qualifications stated separately; no blind merge of external scores
source_correction_boundary: no new primary-source unit investigation; retain quarantines; no value repair

class_graph_discordance.policy: all 9619 preserved; primary result called annotation-stratified; use same saved test predictions excluding flagged rows as required sensitivity; do not guess corrected chemistry
